summary: 终端命令行需要共享的光标动画，替代浏览器原生闪烁
expected: 聚焦且光标折叠时由组件绘制呼吸式光标；选区、IME 合成、密码遮罩、disabled、readonly、reduced-motion 与 forced-colors 下回退原生 caret
acceptanceCriteria: 光标颜色取 --neoverse-terminal-cursor，节奏由共享 motion token 控制
选区、中文合成、password、disabled 与 readonly 保持原生 caret 行为
prefers-reduced-motion 下停用动画，forced-colors 下不绘制自绘光标
Vue 与 React 适配输出一致的 data-caret 标记与光标层结构
XCA-Portal 终端命令行与组件单测、类型检查通过

consumers.scenario: 首页终端命令输入行需要与站点动画语言一致的光标反馈

resolution: Caret cadence tokens in packages/tokens/src/motion.css; overlay caret in packages/tailwind/src/components/terminal.css with native fallback for selection, IME, password, readonly/disabled and forced-colors; Vue and React UiTerminalPrompt adapters share the data-caret state; unit tests in packages/vue/src/terminal.test.ts and packages/react/src/terminal.test.tsx; UI lint, contracts and terminal-surface/react-parity visual suites pass; XCA-Portal terminal-shared-ui, terminal-completion and terminal-visual-acceptance pass.
